policy_basis: This lane publishes through the repository-wide candidate register (config/release_register.json), not through a bespoke guard branch. The literal all-registry duplicate rule remains unsatisfiable and remains negative: the 13GEMSDOE stride-5 covering lattice lies within 3 px of 5,160,724 / 5,167,373 = 0.998713 of footprint cells, so it flags every non-empty submission, including all nine brief-named files. The register is the only mechanism by which a byte-hashed artifact may be offered as a real submission, and it requires a run card, a measured holdout and a uniqueness record to exist and agree.

artifacts.score_claim: none; a 0.20-0.30 projection only, never a score
